fields.summary: NIDDK's NCT05713799 record describes an oral mirabegron and alpha-lipoic acid crossover pilot in adults with obesity, comparing the combination with mirabegron plus placebo. The 5 October 2026 update remains not yet recruiting, with an estimated 8 October 2026 start, 60 estimated participants and estimated March 2030 completion. Its primary endpoint is insulin sensitivity, with metabolic and exploratory body-composition outcomes.
fields.limitations: First posted in February 2023: an older omission, not an October medicine launch. The 8 October start remains estimated, not actual dosing. No results are posted. The detailed protocol retains a 48-person target while the enrolment field estimates 60; this discrepancy is preserved. Metabolic study aims are not demonstrated weight-loss benefit, a prescribing recommendation or approval of this combination.
